name: BTC vs ETH: USDT/USD Premium & Annualized Basis
description: Cross-asset comparison of Bitcoin and Ethereum USDT/USD premium as a proxy for perpetual futures basis. Uses BTCUSDT/ETHUSDT (Tether spot pairs) vs BTCUSD/ETHUSD (USD spot pairs) to calculate: (1) Daily premium = (USDT_price - USD_price) / USD_price, used as a funding rate proxy; (2) Annualized basis % = premium * 1095 (3 periods/day * 365 days). Dashboard: premium time series, annualized basis time series, premium distribution histogram & boxplot, and summary statistics table.
source:
# =============================================================================
# BTC vs ETH: USDT/USD PREMIUM & ANNUALIZED BASIS
# =============================================================================
# Proxy for perpetual futures funding rate / basis using:
#   - Spot USD prices: BTCUSD, ETHUSD (study assets via market_data_source)
#   - USDT prices: BTCUSDT, ETHUSDT (reference via crypto_pairs)
#
# Metrics:
#   1. Premium (funding rate proxy) = (USDT_price - USD_price) / USD_price
#   2. Annualized Basis % = premium * 1095 (3 periods/day * 365 days)
#
# Assets: BTCUSD, ETHUSD
# Timeframe: Daily
# =============================================================================

# --- Spot USD Prices (study universe) ---
src = market_data_source()()
spot_close = src.c

# --- USDT Reference Prices ---
btcusdt_ref = crypto_pairs(ticker="BTCUSDT")()
ethusdt_ref = crypto_pairs(ticker="ETHUSDT")()

btcusdt_close = btcusdt_ref.c
ethusdt_close = ethusdt_ref.c

# --- Map each asset to its corresponding USDT pair ---
is_btc = is_asset_ref(ticker="BTCUSD")()
usdt_close = conditional_select(is_btc, btcusdt_close, ethusdt_close)

# --- Premium (Funding Rate Proxy) ---
# Premium = (USDT_price - USD_price) / USD_price
premium = (usdt_close - spot_close) / spot_close

# --- Annualized Basis % ---
# 3 funding periods per day (8hr intervals) * 365 days = 1095 periods/year
ann_basis_pct = premium * 1095

# --- Expanding Statistics for Summary Table ---
avg_premium = cumulative(agg=AggregationType.Mean)(premium)
median_premium = cumulative(agg=AggregationType.Median)(premium)
max_premium = cumulative(agg=AggregationType.Max)(premium)
min_premium = cumulative(agg=AggregationType.Min)(premium)
avg_ann_basis = cumulative(agg=AggregationType.Mean)(ann_basis_pct)

# Positive premium rate: premium > 0 → 1, else 0, then expanding mean
is_positive_premium = 1 if premium > 0 else 0
pct_positive = cumulative(agg=AggregationType.Mean)(is_positive_premium)

# --- Timestamps for cs_lines ---
bar_ts = index()

# =============================================================================
# REPORTERS
# =============================================================================

# 1. USDT/USD Premium (Funding Rate Proxy) — BTC vs ETH over time
cs_lines(
    title='USDT/USD Premium (Funding Rate Proxy)',
    category='1. Premium & Basis',
    y_axis_label='Premium',
    y_axis_format=AxisValueFormat.PercentFormat,
    y_axis_dp=4,
    order=1
)(bar_ts, premium)

# 2. Annualized Basis % — BTC vs ETH over time
cs_lines(
    title='Annualized Basis % (USDT/USD Premium × 1095)',
    category='1. Premium & Basis',
    y_axis_label='Annualized Basis %',
    y_axis_format=AxisValueFormat.PercentFormat,
    y_axis_dp=1,
    order=2
)(bar_ts, ann_basis_pct)

# 3. Premium Distribution — per-asset histogram
histogram(
    title='USDT/USD Premium Distribution',
    category='2. Premium Distribution',
    bins=50,
    x_axis_label='Daily Premium',
    y_axis_label='Frequency',
    x_axis_format=AxisValueFormat.PercentFormat,
    fill_color=Color.Blue,
    show_analytics=True,
    order=3
)(premium)

# 4. Premium Distribution — cross-asset boxplot comparison
cs_boxplot(
    title='USDT/USD Premium Distribution: BTC vs ETH',
    category='2. Premium Distribution',
    y_axis_label='Daily Premium',
    y_axis_format=AxisValueFormat.PercentFormat,
    y_axis_dp=4,
    fill_color=Color.Blue,
    show_outliers=True,
    order=4
)(premium)

# 5. Summary Statistics Table
cs_summary_table(
    title='USDT/USD Premium & Basis Summary',
    category='3. Summary',
    agg=AggregationType.Last,
    order=5,
    schema=TableReportSchema(
        columns=[
            ColumnSpec(title='Avg Premium', type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=4),
            ColumnSpec(title='Median Premium', type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=4),
            ColumnSpec(title='Avg Ann. Basis %', type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=1),
            ColumnSpec(title='Max Premium', type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=4),
            ColumnSpec(title='Min Premium', type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=4),
            ColumnSpec(title='% Positive Premium', type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=1)
        ]
    )
)(avg_premium, median_premium, avg_ann_basis, max_premium, min_premium, pct_positive)
